thread:
oliver (partnerships): Heads-up from Datadog: they want a "Trace Snapshot" card we can drop into the marketplace tile and SI kit. Requirements: static demo view, filter by request_id, a sample dashboard JSON for import, and a short alert template for high error-rate during inference. Target launch: May 12-16. Who can take dashboard JSON + alert template?
anika (eng-runtime): I can produce the dashboard JSON. I'll include panels: top traces, span waterfall, span attributes table, and a latency histogram. Will annotate where to swap in customer OTLP endpoints. ETA: 4 days.
sam (obs-integration): I'll own the alert template and the OTEL attribute mapping doc. Proposal for alert: if error span rate > 1% over 1m OR P95 latency > 2s for 5m -> fire. Keep it conservative for demo.
tilly (product): Need a short marketplace note clarifying this is a demo snapshot and that production telemetry must be routed to the customer's Datadog/OTLP collector. I'll draft copy once we have a screenshot/gif.
oliver (partnerships): Great. Two technical asks from Datadog: 1) an example to show how to capture redwood-specific attributes (model, quantization, cache_hit) and 2) a quick CI smoke that verifies traces are ingesting into collector.
anika (eng-runtime): For attributes I'll use the naming pattern: "redwood.model", "redwood.quantized", "redwood.kv.hit". I'll add a mapping table to README so partners can map to their own facets.
sam (obs-integration): CI smoke idea: GH Action that runs sample client -> collector -> uses OTLP GRPC to check for trace with attribute "redwood.model". I'll codify as .github/workflows/smoke-otel.yml. Should be < 30s.
anika (eng-runtime): Sample docker-compose snippet for partners:
```yaml
version: '3'
services:
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:latest
    command: ["--config=/etc/otel/config.yaml"]
  sample-app:
    build: .
    environment:
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4317
      - REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-7b
```
sam (obs-integration): Quick dashboard JSON snippet (panel skeleton) I'll put in README as example snippet:
```json
{"title":"Top Traces","type":"trace_list","query":"service:redwood-inference"}
```
not a full dashboard, just a placeholder.
tilly (product): Data residency FAQ: add a bullet: "Demo data is synthetic and stored in staging. For production, telemetry is not routed to Redwood; configure your Datadog/OTLP endpoint or use Private deployment with KMS."
oliver (partnerships): Ownership: Anika = dashboard JSON + sample infra, Sam = alert template + CI smoke workflow, Tilly = marketplace copy + FAQ. I'll coordinate Datadog comms.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging/trace-snapshot-demo -> 2026-05-08T02:00:00Z (approx).
anika (eng-runtime): Repo name: github.com/redwood-inference/trace-snapshot-sample. I'll push initial PR with README and docker-compose.
sam (obs-integration): I'll add a small test script: `python find_trace.py --attribute redwood.model --timeout 20` to validate ingestion.
oliver (partnerships): Deadline: need working CI smoke + dashboard JSON by May 8 to meet May 12-16 window. Flag now if slip.
tilly (product): I'm good on copy timeline. Can someone grab a 10s gif of the Trace Snapshot UI for the tile?
anika (eng-runtime): I'll record a short gif after the PR merges and put it in /assets.
oliver (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll share the May 8 staging link with Datadog and the HW SI leads. :calendar:
